name: OpenVibe.Play

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; the database is what ready checks

resumes.what: sign-in sessions are cookies verified against Network's keys, fetched again at boot
every title, unlock and score is a committed row; posts are idempotent, so a game retries after a restart without counting twice
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates Play's own tables

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site and the API

notes: Port 5040, unit openvibe-play.service, play.openvibe.network (the openvibe.network wildcard certificate). The platform's game services (OpenVibe.Games ADR-0007 decision 10): titles registered by their own principal, achievements and leaderboards (best or sum, this week and all time), idempotent score and unlock posts, guest adoption, in its own PostgreSQL database (ov_play). OpenVibe.Games is its first title owner (Scraplandia, Salvage Rush). People's rows are in the account export and erased with the account (ADR-033).

site.name: Play
site.tagline: Achievements, leaderboards and cloud saves for every game.
site.what: See this week's leaders and the all-time boards of every OpenVibe game, every achievement you have unlocked, and the saves games keep for you so your progress follows you to any device.

faq.question: What is OpenVibe Play?
faq.answer: Game services for every OpenVibe game: achievements, leaderboards (this week and all time) and cloud saves that follow you to any device.

faq.question: Can my game use it?
faq.answer: Yes. A game registers its title with its own OpenVibe token, posts what its players did, and anyone can read its boards.

faq.question: What happens to a guest's progress?
faq.answer: When a guest signs in, the game adopts them and their unlocks and scores become the person's.
